request.prompt:
Create a dedicated MYTHIC boss animation source sheet for exactly the supplied character, preserving its unique costume/materials/anatomy. A massive unique winged demon overlord, huge dark red muscular biped torso, bull-like horned demonic head with two wide black curled horns, large leathery dark bat WINGS attached to back, segmented black/gold spiked shoulder/forearm/shin armor, heavy gold chain loincloth, thick dark-red tail and clawed feet. One huge black iron sword in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT claw empty. Wing membranes, horn breadth and gold armor define its own silhouette; not the wingless Albino Demon.
Fixed camera throughout this sheet: SOUTHWEST front three-quarter facing DOWN-LEFT. Anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is far/screenLEFT, LEFT empty hand near/screenRIGHT.
Action IDLE: Six subtly distinct continuous alert breathing poses: neutral, inhale begins, chest/shoulders rise, peak breath, exhale, near-neutral settle. Grounded feet stay at fixed points; use mild cape/hair/wing motion, no whole-body translations.
CORRECTION: The FIRST reference establishes identity ONLY and may face the wrong side. The SECOND reference establishes a reviewed same-character camera direction. Adopt the required camera below consistently for ALL SIX poses; never copy the first reference camera automatically.
The nose/beak/muzzle/helmet front MUST point toward SCREEN LEFT in EVERY ready, loading, contact, recoil, and restored pose. Hips, knees, feet and torso must face LEFT too. Front LEFT three-quarter: show front chest AND leftward profile; viewer sees near LEFT side; not front-right.
Exactly ONE anatomical RIGHT-held weapon throughout if the character uses one; never hand swap or duplicate. Left hand stays free. Natural head recoil is fine without changing the overall facing.
Layout EXACTLY SIX COMPLETE distinct animation poses in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS (2x3), read row-major 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5, WIDE LANDSCAPE transparent canvas. Keep each figure body about200px high with identical scale. Each full silhouette including extended wings, scythe, axe, staff, sword, tail and cape must fit comfortably inside its own large cell with generous empty alpha gutters and outside margins. No pose or weapon intersects another; no anatomy reaches canvas edge. No floor/shadow/effects/text. Preserve character identity and action sequence. Not flipped, no mirrored anatomy.
